integrity: The proof uses standard transfer, FKG and Holley results with hypotheses stated. Exact rational finite checks corroborate but do not prove the infinite-family claim. Historical originality is provisional pending independent literature audit.
scientific_limitations: Uniform interior-volume measures in canonical Euclidean poset coordinates only; no Loewner-order comparison of full covariance matrices, no affine-invariant isotropic-constant statement, and no unrestricted marked-poset version.
title: Coordinatewise Euclidean inertia dominance for every order–chain polytope pair
